| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 10 px | The size of the Gaussian. The kernels end at 4 sigma. |
| **Derivative** `order` | First derivative (edges) | First derivative (edges), Second derivative (lines) | Which derivative of the Gaussian to steer. |
| **Angle** `angle` | 0 | 0 to 360 deg | The direction of the derivative. 0 points along x. Angles turn counterclockwise. |
| **Output** `output` | Steered to the angle | Steered to the angle, Strongest over all angles, Angle of the strongest response | The response at the chosen angle, the largest response over all angles, or the angle where it is reached. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
